Forecast chart of a coin

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_forecast.Rd

The last closes of a coin and the forecast of its next days from the GARCH model of volatility_analysis(): the median close, and the ranges of the middle half and of probability level, which start from the last close. Hover over the median line for the ranges of a day. It is the lower panel of plot_volatility(), on its own.

Usage

plot_forecast(analysis, mode = "light", context_days = 30)

Arguments

analysis

The result of volatility_analysis(), with a forecast: there is none when the GARCH model could not be fitted.

mode

"light" (the default) or "dark", to suit a light or dark page.

context_days

Closes before the forecast.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

btc <- get_history("Bitcoin (BTC)", as.Date("2013-04-29"))
plot_forecast(volatility_analysis(btc))


# the next 14 days after the last 60 closes
plot_forecast(volatility_analysis(btc, forecast_days = 14), context_days = 60)
